body:
## Pull request overview

This PR wires the existing Agent → Tool architecture into a usable **metadata_assistant** agent, exposes an **agent listing endpoint** for the Studio UI, and enhances the Studio **AiChatPanel** to support agent selection and rendering of Vercel AI SDK v6 tool-invocation message parts.

**Changes:**
- Add `metadata_assistant` built-in agent and export/register it through `service-ai`.
- Introduce `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` and `AgentRuntime.listAgents()` for an agent selector UI.
- Update Studio `AiChatPanel` to support agent selection + tool invocation rendering, and add corresponding tests.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

`requiresConfirmation: true` is set here, but the AI service currently executes tool calls immediately in `AIService.chatWithTools/streamChatWithTools` via `ToolRegistry.executeAll` without checking this flag, and the stream encoder never emits an approval/deny state. This means create_object will still run without any user confirmation. Either implement a server-side approval gate for tools marked `requiresConfirmation` (emit an approval-requested part and wait for client response) or remove the flag until it’s enforced end-to-end.
```suggestion

```

Same issue as `create_object`: `requiresConfirmation: true` is declared but not enforced anywhere in the service’s tool-call loop or streaming protocol, so `delete_field` will execute immediately when the model requests it. Please add server-side confirmation handling for `requiresConfirmation` tools (so the UI can approve/deny) or drop the flag to avoid a false sense of safety.
```suggestion

```

`formatToolArgs()` can throw at runtime: `JSON.stringify(v)` returns `undefined` for `undefined`/functions (and throws for `bigint`), but the code assumes `val` is always a string and accesses `val.length`. Consider coercing non-stringified values via `String(v)` (and catching stringify errors) so a single unexpected arg doesn’t crash the chat panel render.

`formatToolOutput()` has the same failure mode as `formatToolArgs`: `JSON.stringify(output)` can return `undefined` (or throw) but the code unconditionally reads `raw.length`. Guard against `undefined`/non-serializable outputs (fallback to empty string / String(output)) to avoid crashing when `part.output` is missing or not JSON-serializable.

Persisted `selectedAgent` is used to build the transport URL immediately, but the value is never validated against the fetched agent list. If the server doesn’t expose agent routes (no metadata service) or the previously selected agent is inactive/removed, the panel will keep calling `/api/v1/ai/agents/{agent}/chat` and fail until the user manually switches back. Suggest: once `agentsLoading` finishes, if `selectedAgent` isn’t `__general__` and isn’t in `agents`, automatically fall back to `__general__` (and update localStorage).
